inputs.required_output: select host service, privileged builder capsule, or scoped guest service as S2's builder substrate, or falsify all three with evidence

evidence.sealed_guest: no shell, vsock, serial, capsule, exec, build, mount, or snapshot endpoint reachable on :8085 or host vmctl; every guest-internal observation path is closed
evidence.erofs_store: guest /nix/store is EROFS read-only with 898 entries; no writable scratch or overlay path exposed
evidence.no_build_surface: no dependency build, package install, or capsule-create surface exists
evidence.no_snapshot_surface: vmctl exposes resolve/resume/recover/refresh/runtime-package and no snapshot/UFFD/reflink handler
evidence.m9a_positive: platform-signed update applied and restored with witness match — the only end-to-end lifecycle the sealed boundary actually admitted

host_service.evidence: host-side surfaces (vmctl, corpusd, node-b state dir) are reachable and already carry the M9a/restore/health evidence; nothing measured rules out a host-side builder substrate

privileged_builder_capsule.evidence: no capsule-create/namespace/exec endpoint exists today, so the privileged-capsule substrate is unfalsified but also unexercised; S2 entry for this branch must add a capsule-namespace probe precondition

scoped_guest_service.evidence: the guest is sealed by design, /nix/store is EROFS, and no install or build surface exists; a scoped guest service would have to be constructed, not assumed present. The gaps weaken it as the default, but do not prove it impossible.

decision.rationale: None of the three substrates is falsified: the gaps measure the current deployed surface, not the design space. The decision correctly moves to S2 carrying three binding requirements — (1) whichever substrate is chosen must expose the missing observation/build surfaces S0b could not reach; (2) if S2 picks privileged_builder_capsule, the capsule-namespace probe set is an S2-entry precondition; (3) the M9a route-projection defect (docs/problems/s0-m9a-route-projection-owner-binding-2026-10-04.md) is early-S2 work, since any builder substrate needs route projection to publish artifacts.
